description: Tests a string against prefix, suffix, and contains conditions. Outputs true when all non-empty conditions match. Wire a Name or Path property node to the Input port.

outputs.result: starts_with(if(match_case, input, lower(input)), if(match_case, prefix, lower(prefix))) && ends_with(if(match_case, input, lower(input)), if(match_case, suffix, lower(suffix))) && contains(if(match_case, input, lower(input)), if(match_case, contains, lower(contains)))

label: Text Filter
